lead: eight licensed Kevin MacLeod expedition songs via PLANET_MUSIC.json
weapon_voices: removed from combat, shop preview and codex; legacy sources archived only
chart: per-planet lane phrases with rests and strong-onset alignment, opening half-time taps, holds, chords after sector one, and cross-lane rolls after sector two; preview divided by the live song rate
song_rate: 1.00 plus 0.045 per finished objective, up to 1.18; OGG playback and score mapping advance together
inner_planet_phrasing: Venus uses longer sustains, Earth emphasizes doubled downbeats, Mars uses short accents and more ordered rolls
ammo: square(sum(all3keys earned)/sum(all3keys possible)) sets next6second base ammo; multiply current earnedPerfect bonus,max120percent;opening100percent;zero/recovery and fraction carry retained
campaign_volley: the first musical completion at or after charge on every planet; taps and chords use the landing, holds and ordered rolls use the tail; existing on-screen gestures keep their shape through rate changes
mercury_difficulty: 3.55 s base preview before rate adjustment; after beacon one skip beat four input in each bar, with some rolls simplified; six-second base ammo has a 50% floor and can fall at most 30 percentage points per scored window
feedback: independent kill, pickup, shield, impact, UI, alert and rhythm buses; CC0 contact clicks mixed with original electronic accents for accepted gestures

rhythm_feedback.early_contact: immediate strike and displayed provisional grade, followed by one scored judgement without replaying the ordinary contact
rhythm_feedback.centered_contact: a Perfect within 45 ms adds a white strike accent and emphasizes existing rhythm samples by up to 1.2 dB before voice headroom and bus limiting; no new judgement grade
rhythm_feedback.volley_visual: actual nonzero volleys pulse beside the ship and on the ammo readout; no weapon voice is played

perfect_rewards.scope: immediate multiplier on accuracy-squared ammo, not points or damage; count caps remain

damage_growth: Central bounded attribute/level/modifier growth and full-count density sharing before score scaling. Accuracy itself only scales count. Utility dash missiles follow count ratio.
